technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early momentum recovery signals conflict with bearish price structure, weak trend confirmation, and negative volume flow—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: CSGP shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 55 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with only junior-level small purchases 90 days ago; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (229) indicates extreme market stress, and real estate sector faces credit tightening; earnings in 55 days adds event risk but is secondary to systemic conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with StochRSI bullish cross and EMA 50/200 alignment provide textbook mean-reversion setup in fear-driven market (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structure remains bearish below all key moving averages (EMA 9/21/50), volume is weak, CMF negative, ADX shows no trend conviction, and macro environment is severely unfavorable (inverted yield curve, credit stress, earnings risk in 55 days)—momentum signals lack confluence with price action.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with StochRSI bullish cross presents textbook mean-reversion setup at support in fear-driven market. However, bearish price structure below all key moving averages, negative volume flow (CMF), and weak trend confirmation (ADX) lack sufficient confluence for conviction entry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment severely unfavorable with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (229), and credit stress; real estate sector faces headwinds, and earnings in 55 days present event risk that could trigger further downside despite oversold technicals.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical oversold signals conflict sharply with bearish price structure and macro headwinds; fundamental and risk agents strongly negative; sentiment offers only weak contrarian support.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 8 Real Estate positions and existing CSGP position; sector concentration and ticker overlap reduce conviction further—skip to preserve capital in unfavorable macro environment.
